subject: executor: fix index_hash_join hang when context canceled (#54855)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s executor changes in `pkg/executor/join`: it propagates `ctx.Err()` into `indexHashJoinResult.err` when ctx is canceled while acquiring a new result chunk or while sending a full chunk, and adds a regression test (via `failpoint.InjectCall`) that cancels in the send→getNewJoinResult window. Traced the surrounding cancellation/error paths (`doJoinUnordered`/`handleTask`/`getResultFromChannel`) and found no remaining Blocker/High issues; upstream/master retains this cancellation-propagation logic (tests were later reorganized, and there were additional unrelated robustness fixes later).
